title: 第21章 弟子眼里的噩梦第22章 坦坦荡荡不怕
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
苏凡古怪的瞧着李有德，思索片刻，说道：“有难同当，才是你最想表达的吧！”
这酒窖有没有主人，尚且不知。
可如果有，必然是宗门里的一位大人物，因为这里属于宗门地界，不可能有外人。
凭他们这点实力，根本得罪不起。
所以从表面上看，这胖子很义气，但其实是想拖他下水，共担风险。
这死胖子，很不地道。
“怎么可能？我对凡哥的真诚和情义，那是天地可鉴。”
李有德大义凛凛。
但心里，却颇为懊恼。
一个十二岁的小屁孩怎么就这么精明？跟个老狐狸一样。
苏凡直翻白眼。
认识还不到十二个时辰，跟他谈什么真诚和情义？真把他当小孩。
“凡哥，这样说吧，就算是有主之物又怎么样？谁知道是我们偷走的？”
李有德一个劲的怂恿。
反正，不把苏凡拖下水，誓不罢休。
“野猴子知道。”
野猴子知道这里的机关，如果这些酒真是有主之物，那野猴子肯定认识酒窖的主人。
如果是一般的妖兽，倒也无所谓。
可这野猴子天生通灵，能跟人沟通交流。
到时野猴子，直接带着酒窖的主人，跑来指认他们，还不得倒大霉？

所以思前想后，最明智的选择就是赶紧开溜。
任李有德说得天花乱坠，苏凡也不听，转身飞快的朝隧洞外跑去。
“小屁孩就是小屁孩，一遇到事跑得比兔子还快。”
李有德鄙夷，搓着手，抱着一个酒坛，正准备打开来尝尝。
“说谁是小屁孩？”
可突然。
苏凡又折道而返，眼底藏着一抹奸笑。
死胖子，想坑小爷是吧，小爷先坑死你。
李有德立马变脸，奉承道：“凡哥就算是个小屁孩，也是一个英明神武的小少年。”
苏凡白了眼他，扫向酒窖里的酒坛，问道：“一人一半？”
“完全没问题。”
李有德连连点头。
“那就赶紧的，等带回去再慢慢品尝。”
苏凡掏出一个储物袋，便钻进酒窖，疯狂扫荡。
李有德也生怕吃亏。
一小会儿的功夫，酒窖就一扫而空，每人得到六十五坛。
总共也就是一百三十坛。
……
外面。
夜黑如墨。
content_en:
Su Fan looked at Li Youde strangely, thought for a moment, and said, "We share the same difficulties, that's what you want to express most!"
It is not known whether this wine cellar has an owner.
But if there is, it must be a big shot in the sect, because this place belongs to the sect's territory and there can be no outsiders.
With their little strength, they simply cannot afford to offend.
So on the surface, the fat man seemed very loyal, but in fact he wanted to drag him into the water and share the risk.
This damn fat guy is very unkind.
"How is that possible? My sincerity and affection for Brother Fan are something that can be learned from both heaven and earth."
Li Youde was upright and upright.
But in my heart, I was quite upset.
How can a twelve-year-old kid be so smart? Like an old fox.
Su Fan rolled his eyes.
We have known each other for less than twelve hours, how can we talk about sincerity and friendship with him? He really treated him like a child.
"Brother Fan, let's put it this way, so what if it belongs to the owner? Who knew we stole it?"
Li Youde kept encouraging.
Anyway, I won't give up until Su Fan is dragged into the water.
"Wild monkeys know."
The wild monkey knows the mechanism here. If these wines really belong to the owner, then the wild monkey must know the owner of the wine cellar.
If it were an ordinary monster, it wouldn't matter.
But this wild monkey is naturally psychic and can communicate with people.
When the wild monkey comes and identifies them directly with the owner of the wine cellar, what will happen?
So after thinking about it, the wisest choice is to run away quickly.
No matter what Li Youde said, Su Fan didn't listen and turned around and ran out of the tunnel quickly.
"A brat is a brat, and when something happens he can run faster than a rabbit."
Li Youde was disdainful, rubbing his hands and holding a wine jar, about to open it and taste it.
"Who are you calling a brat?"
But suddenly.
Su Fan turned back again, with a sinister smile hidden in his eyes.
You damn fat man, you want to trick me, right? I will trick you first.
Li Youde immediately changed his face and said flatteringly: "Even if Brother Fan is a little kid, he is still a wise and martial young man."
Su Fan rolled his eyes at him, glanced at the wine jar in the wine cellar, and asked, "Half for each person?"
"No problem at all."
Li Youde nodded repeatedly.
"Then hurry up and taste it slowly when you take it back."
Su Fan took out a storage bag, got into the wine cellar, and searched frantically.
Li Youde was also afraid of suffering a loss.
In a short time, the wine cellar was completely emptied, and each person received sixty-five jars.
A total of one hundred and thirty altars.
……
Outside.
The night is as black as ink.
